articles.headline: Vikings activate RB Jordan Mason off injured reserve
articles.description: The Vikings activated running back Jordan Mason from injured reserve Saturday, completing his recovery from a fractured thumb that required surgery last month.
articles.headlineJa: バイキングス、RBジョーダン・メイソンを負傷者リストから復帰させる
articles.descriptionJa: バイキングスは土曜日、ランニングバックのジョーダン・メイソンを負傷者リストから復帰させた。これにより、先月手術を受けた親指の骨折からの回復が完了した。
articles.body:
EAGAN, Minn. -- The Minnesota Vikings activated running back Jordan Mason from injured reserve Saturday, completing his recovery from a fractured thumb that required surgery last month.

The Vikings had already created a spot for Mason on the 53-man roster Friday by releasing running back DeeJay Dallas, who re-signed Saturday to the Vikings' practice squad and was elevated to the game-day roster for Sunday's matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

Mason is expected to split time against the Indianapolis Colts with teammate Aaron Jones Sr., who took 90% of the Vikings' running back carries in Mason's absence.

"Getting Jordan back, I think, will be a really positive thing, just because of the offseason he had and the excitement," coach Kevin O'Connell said Friday after Mason completed a week of practice with no setbacks. "My excitement to see him paired with Aaron, and how we go about the usage there, is going to be an exciting thing because we feel so confident in both of them. But with the workload Aaron's had and the type of warrior he's been, it'll be good to have JP back."

In his only appearance this season, Mason carried 15 times for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 39-22 victory over the Green Bay Packers. He reported thumb soreness the following day, leading to the discovery of a small fracture.

In his second season with the Vikings, Mason has rushed for 2,070 yards and 14 touchdowns since joining the San Francisco 49ers in 2022.

articles.headline: Michael Carrick vows Man United will be 'different team' against Bournemouth
articles.description: Michael Carrick has promised Manchester United fans they will see "a different team" against Bournemouth after the humiliating loss to Como.
articles.headlineJa: マイケル・キャリック、ボーンマス戦ではマン・ユナイテッドが「別チーム」になると誓う
articles.descriptionJa: コモに屈辱的な敗戦を喫した後、マイケル・キャリックはマンチェスター・ユナイテッドのファンに対し、ボーンマス戦では「別チーム」のような姿を見せると約束した。
articles.body:
Michael Carrick has promised Manchester United fans they will see "a different team" against Bournemouth after the humiliating loss to Como.

Carrick apologised to supporters following the 4-1 defeat in Italy on Wednesday.

The 45-year-old is battling to save his job, but insisted he "trusts" his players to put in a completely different performance when Bournemouth visit Old Trafford on Sunday.

"I definitely trust them, yeah, 100% I trust them," Carrick said.

"It wasn't a very good night at all [against Como] for so many reasons. We all know that. I think that's pretty obvious. I definitely trust them, yeah. I trust them. We'll be a different team on Sunday. We have to be a different team on Sunday."

United have been criticised for a perceived lack of effort in games this season having been out-run by a number of opponents.

Carrick appeared to hint at something similar after the defeat to Como when he responded to criticism of his tactics from Bruno Fernandes by saying: "If you don't run, and you don't run forward, and you don't run back, you aren't going to win."

But asked on Friday whether a lack of running and a reluctance to press was contributing to the poor run of results, Carrick insisted it's not the main reason behind the slump.

- Carrick doesn't rule out dropping Fernandes for United's Bournemouth clash 

- Carrick: Under-pressure Man United boss '100%' backs himself amid tension 

- Who's to blame for Man United mess: Carrick, the players ... Ratcliffe?

"I think you've got to be careful with just saying 'not running,'" he said.

"You don't necessarily need to press to win games of football. Sometimes you do, sometimes you don't. It's just a thing that gets thrown about.

"So we've got to be a bit careful with that. It's not necessarily just running stats that define football games either.

"We've just got to get back to doing a lot of the things that we were doing last season. We need to get back to being at our best."

articles.headline: Álvarez's 1st LaLiga home goal in 11 months sees Atlético  close gap to Barça
articles.description: Julián Álvarez scored his first LaLiga goal in eight months as Atlético Madrid beat Deportivo 1-0 to climb to within two points of leaders Barcelona.
articles.headlineJa: アルバレスが11ヶ月ぶりのラ・リーガ・ホームゴールを記録、アトレティコがバルサとの差を縮める
articles.descriptionJa: ジュリアン・アルバレスが8ヶ月ぶりのラ・リーガでのゴールを決め、アトレティコ・マドリードがデポルティーボに1-0で勝利。首位バルセロナとの勝ち点差を2に縮めた。
articles.body:
Julián Álvarez scored his first LaLiga goal in eight months as Atlético Madrid beat Deportivo 1-0 to climb to within two points of leaders Barcelona.

Álvarez, who was involved in a contentious transfer saga involving Barcelona this summer, scored the game's only goal early in the second half. The Argentina forward was making his first league start of the season and his goal was his first in front of Atlético's home fans in the league since November 2025. 

The goal was enough as Atlético extended their unbeaten run to eight matches before Barca take on Real Madrid at Camp Nou in Sunday's Clásico.

Atlético's six-game winning run in all competitions was halted in Tuesday's 1-1 Champions League draw in Stuttgart and they came under early pressure against Deportivo.

Visiting defender Miguel Loureiro's header was saved by Atlético goalkeeper Jan Oblak, who pulled off two more in quick succession midway through the first half to keep out Yeremay Hernández's long-range effort and Lorenzo Amatucci's follow-up.

Atlético stirred themselves as half-time approached, but they failed to trouble Depor goalkeeper Leo Román as shots from Lee Kang-In, Pablo Barrios and Morten Hjulmand were all off target.

Atlético boss Diego Simeone sent on son Giuliano Simeone and Robin Le Normand in place of Barrios and Ademola Lookman at the start of the second half and the changes had an immediate impact.

Alejandro Grimaldo provided the cross and Álvarez converted from close range to make it two goals in as many matches having scored the equaliser at Stuttgart in midweek.

Atlético stepped it up in pursuit of a second. Álex Baena's effort from outside the box was saved by Roman and the Spain midfielder had another shot blocked before Dávid Hancko and Simeone fired high and wide.

The home side continued to threaten, but Álvarez and Simeone were thwarted by Román before Depor went close to snatching a point through Kevin Sanchez's stoppage-time shot, which was superbly saved by Oblak.

PA contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Eagles' DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks out vs. Cowboys
articles.description: The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Cowboys.
articles.headlineJa: イーグルスのデヴォンタ・スミスとドンタイビオン・ウィックス、カウボーイズ戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: イーグルスのトップレシーバーであるデヴォンタ・スミスとドンタイビオン・ウィックスの2名が、月曜夜のカウボーイズ戦を欠場することが決定した。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- The Eagles' top two receivers -- DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks -- have been ruled out of Monday night's game against the Dallas Cowboys.

Smith has been dealing with hamstring issues since the summer, when he was sidelined for a portion of training camp.

He tweaked his hamstring Week 2 against the Tennessee Titans, saying recently that he thought being dehydrated in the Nashville heat was a contributing factor. He played through the injury the following week but missed the next two games before returning last Sunday against the Carolina Panthers, catching seven balls for 75 yards and a touchdown. Smith was unable to practice this week.

Wicks appeared on the practice report this week with an ankle injury. This will be the first time he'll miss a game with the Eagles.

Tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) expects to play despite missing the first two days of practice this week. The Eagles' offense could also welcome back Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and lineman Landon Dickerson (knee/pec), both of whom are questionable.

Nolan Smith (concussion) has been ruled out, while fellow edge rusher Jonathan Greenard (ankle) is questionable, telling reporters Friday that he is a game-time decision.

articles.headline: Packers activate RB Josh Jacobs for 2026 debut
articles.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut against the Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.
articles.headlineJa: パッカーズ、RBジョシュ・ジェイコブスをアクティブにし2026年シーズン初出場へ
articles.descriptionJa: パッカーズのランニングバック、ジョシュ・ジェイコブスは、NFLコミッショナー免除リストに6週間入っていた後、ライオンズ戦で2026年シーズン初出場を果たす。
articles.body:
GREEN BAY, Wis. -- Packers running back Josh Jacobs will make his 2026 season debut Sunday against the Detroit Lions after spending the first six weeks on the NFL's commissioner exempt list.

Green Bay added him to the active roster from exempt status Saturday. The NFL took Jacobs off the exempt list Monday.

The NFL's investigation of Jacobs for potential violations of the personal conduct policy following his arrest earlier this year on misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor destruction of property charges remains active, and a suspension could be equal to or greater than the number of games he already missed. The six games he has missed would be credited toward any suspension.

For now, Jacobs is cleared to play. 

Jacobs pleaded no contest Sept. 10 to the charges resulting from the May 23 incident with a woman at his home near Green Bay. He was convicted of battery and fined $1,000 and reached a deferred judgment agreement on the property damage charge.

Without Jacobs, the Packers have had the worst running game in the NFL, ranking last in rushing yards per game at 59.8 yards. Jacobs was the Packers' leading rusher the previous two seasons, ranking eighth in the league in combined rushing yards (2,258) and tied for fourth in rushing touchdowns (28) during the 2024 and 2025 seasons.

The Packers also signed WR/KR Coleman Owen to the active roster off the practice squad, elevated edge rusher Arron Mosby from the practice squad for game day, and activated defensive tackle Jordon Riley off the physically unable to perform list.

articles.headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
articles.description: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.
articles.headlineJa: レイブンズ、ベンガルズ戦にラマー・ジャクソン（足首）を欠場、タイラー・“スヌープ”・ハントリーが先発へ
articles.descriptionJa: ボルチモア・レイブンズは、足首の高位捻挫が続いているため、日曜日のシンシナティ・ベンガルズ戦にQBラマー・ジャクソンを欠場させると発表した。先発はタイラー・“スヌープ”・ハントリーが務める。
articles.body:
BALTIMORE -- The Baltimore Ravens ruled out quarterback Lamar Jackson for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.

On Saturday, the Ravens downgraded Jackson, who had been listed as questionable with a left ankle injury after being limited all week in practice.

Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will start for the Ravens for the third straight week.

Since 2019, the Ravens are 0-3, including the playoffs, against the Bengals without Jackson as their starting quarterback.

articles.headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta collecting evidence on rival managers after yellow card
articles.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he has a "massive storage of images" showing rival Premier League managers breaking touchline rules after receiving his second yellow card of the season.
articles.headlineJa: アーセナルのミケル・アルテタ、イエローカード受領後、ライバル監督たちの証拠を収集
articles.descriptionJa: アーセナルのミケル・アルテタ監督は、今シーズン2枚目のイエローカードを受けた後、プレミアリーグのライバル監督たちがタッチラインのルールに違反している様子を捉えた「膨大な画像データ」を持っていると語った。
articles.body:
LONDON -- Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he has a "massive storage of images" showing rival Premier League managers breaking touchline rules after receiving his second yellow card of the season during his team's 2-0 win against Everton on Saturday.

Arsenal moved level on points with leaders Manchester City, who lost 2-1 at Aston Villa, as goals from Ezri Konsa and Gabriel Magalhães sealed victory against David Moyes' team.

- Arise Arsenal, the people's Premier League champions

- Arteta admits Saka injury signs are 'not good'

- Tottenham's rare win at Chelsea signals progress under De Zerbi

Moyes and Arteta's assistant, Gabriel Heinze, were also booked by referee Tony Harrington during a bad-tempered game, but despite the official issuing those yellow cards, Arteta suggested he was being harshly treated by saying other managers leave the technical area more than he does.

"There are managers that have the record in the league -- 36 times in 10 minutes leaving the touchline, no yellows," Arteta told reporters.

"So I'm clipping all of that. I have a massive storage of images. So if somebody is going to say, 'I'm not in the record yet, somebody else has the record,' then it's 36 yellow cards in 10 minutes for the [other] manager."

Arteta has developed a reputation for being an active presence on the touchline and regularly leaves his technical area during games, despite regulations not allowing that.

The Arsenal manager will be issued with a one-match touchline ban if he receives a third yellow card and he said he would need "sensors" to prevent him from leaving his technical area and earning another yellow.

"I do have to be careful," he said. "And we need to have good sensors there."

articles.headline: Dele Alli proves Spurs' good luck charm at Stamford Bridge again
articles.description: Dele Alli was the hero during Tottenham's win at Chelsea in 2018 and he provided good luck for his old club on Saturday after he watched on at Stamford Bridge.
articles.headlineJa: デレ・アッリが再びスタンフォード・ブリッジでスパーズのラッキーチャームとなる
articles.descriptionJa: 2018年にチェルシー戦でトッテナムを勝利に導いたヒーローであったデレ・アッリが、土曜日にスタンフォード・ブリッジで観戦し、古巣に再び幸運をもたらした。
articles.body:
Dele Alli was the hero during Tottenham's win at Chelsea in 2018 and he provided good luck for his old club on Saturday after he watched on at Stamford Bridge.

An own-goal by Mike Penders and Mathys Tel's superb solo effort inspired Spurs to only a second victory at Chelsea in the Premier League era for a statement result for Roberto De Zerbi's new-look group.

One of those in attendance was former Tottenham attacker Dele, who posted on his Instagram story a selfie at Stamford Bridge alongside ex-Chelsea captain John Terry.

Dele, 30, has not played since a spell with Como during the 2024-25 season, but has been active on social media in recent weeks and teased his followers with an image asking "who can guess where I'm going?" before it was followed by an image of Stamford Bridge.

A shot alongside Terry was sent out pre-match and Dele then filmed the scoreboard as Spurs went ahead in the 77th minute.

- Tottenham's rare win at Chelsea signals progress under De Zerbi

- James Maddison's injury woes return, forced off for Tottenham vs. Chelsea

- Cole Palmer sent off for first time, Chelsea reach unwanted red card milestone

And the one-time England international poked fun at Chelsea at full-time with a picture on his story that was captioned "empty seat here now" with Terry nowhere to be seen as Dele savoured Tottenham ending their Stamford Bridge hoodoo.

articles.headline: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
articles.description: Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced. He will not play against the Spurs.
articles.headlineJa: マベリックスのクーパー・フラッグ、左肩の軽度捻挫によりホーム開幕戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: マベリックスのスターフォワード、クーパー・フラッグのMRI検査により左肩の軽度捻挫が判明したとチームが発表した。彼はスパーズ戦には出場しない。
articles.body:
DALLAS -- Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI on Saturday morning that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced.

Flagg has been ruled out of Saturday night's home opener against the San Antonio Spurs. He will be reevaluated next week.

The reigning Rookie of the Year, Flagg suffered the injury when he took a flagrant foul by Indiana Pacers forward Aaron Nesmith on a breakaway late in the second quarter of the Mavericks' road win Friday night. Flagg exited moments later and did not return to the game.

Flagg, 19, was off to a fast start in his second season. He scored 32 points in Wednesday's loss to the Houston Rockets, the highest-scoring performance ever by a teenager in a season opener. He had 14 points, six assists, five rebounds, three steals and a block in 17 minutes before exiting against the Pacers.

articles.headline: Magic's Paolo Banchero has ankle sprain; out multiple weeks, sources say
articles.description: Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced, with sources telling ESPN that the forward will miss multiple weeks.
articles.body:
Orlando Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced Saturday, with sources telling ESPN's Shams Charania that the forward will miss multiple weeks.

This injury diagnosis typically carries a timetable of four to six weeks.

Banchero was injured in the first half of Friday night's 115-93 loss to the visiting Minnesota Timberwolves. He told The Orlando Sentinel after the game that he began experiencing discomfort in the first quarter.

He sat out the fourth quarter and finished with 14 points and six rebounds.

Last season, the Magic outscored opponents by 45 points in the 182 minutes that Banchero, Franz Wagner, Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane and Wendell Carter Jr. were on the court together. They collectively shot 50.1% from the field and 36.4% from 3-point range while holding opponents to 46.2% overall shooting and 34.5% 3-point shooting.

The Magic are 40-26 over the past three regular seasons when the quartet of Banchero, Wagner, Suggs and Carter all play. They went 7-3 in 10 games without Banchero last season.

Over the past two seasons combined, Banchero has missed 46 games, Wagner 70 and Suggs 72, yet the Magic still reached the playoffs both years.

Banchero was off to a flying start this season, averaging team highs of 24.5 points and 7.5 assists per game, along with 6.5 rebounds and doing all that on 70% shooting.

For his career, the 2022 No. 1 draft pick and 2024 All-Star is averaging 22.4 points, 7.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists per game for Orlando.

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
articles.description: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- LeBron James will miss Saturday night's game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica, the 76ers announced.

Saturday marks the start of Philadelphia's first back-to-back; they play the Detroit Pistons on Sunday, also at home. James missed the opening 14 games of last season with sciatica, which is the irritation of a nerve that runs through the gluteal muscles, hamstrings, lower leg and foot.

James, 41, hasn't said publicly that he has had any injury flare-ups this season. As his injury designation suggests, this appears to be managing the past injury over a long season for the NBA's oldest player.

After two games this season, James is averaging 15.5 points and leads the 76ers in rebounds (9.5) and assists (6.0) per game.

Forward Dean Wade, who has yet to make his Sixers debut while nursing a left ankle sprain, remains questionable.

articles.headline: NFL Week 7 uniforms: Alternates galore as Texans go battle red, Lions all-black
articles.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 7, led by alternate looks from Houston, Detroit and Dallas.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第7週のユニフォーム：テキサンズの赤、ライオンズのオールブラックなど、多彩なオルタネートが登場
articles.descriptionJa: ヒューストン、デトロイト、ダラスのオルタネート（特別仕様）ユニフォームを中心に、NFL各チームの第7週の着用ウェアを紹介する。
articles.body:
The throwbacks were well-represented in Week 6 of the NFL slate. While that's still the case this week, it's the alternates that lead the way -- including two monochromatic looks from the Houston Texans and Detroit Lions.

Houston will be wearing its "battle red" combination, which the team first unveiled in 2024. It's all red from head to toe complete with a similarly colored matte lid that includes a new bullhorn logo. The numbers are deep steel blue with a liberty white trim, while the red pants boast blue and white stripes. The New York Giants will counter with all-white. 

Also unveiled in 2024, the Lions are rocking their all-black threads against the Green Bay Packers. The black jersey and pants include a Honolulu Blue matte helmet with leaping Lions logo in silver. There's also a black stripe across the middle. Detroit first wore black uniforms in 1948 before bringing it back in 2005 as an alternate. The team stopped wearing them after the 2007 season before returning it in 2024. 

The Dallas Cowboys will don their color rush look against the Philadelphia Eagles on "Monday Night Football." Dallas unveiled these threads in 2015 with a silver helmet before an arctic white one debuted in 2022. The all-white combination has navy blue numbers and on the shoulder for a neat look.

Though alternates are the headliners, fans of the classics aren't leaving empty handed either in Week 7.

The Seattle Seahawks are wearing their throwbacks from the 1990s, complete with royal blue jerseys and silver pants and helmet. Seattle wore them last week on "Thursday Night Football." For the first time this season, the Atlanta Falcons and New York Jets are rocking classic uniforms. New York's is appropriately named "The Classic," and the all-white look pays homage to the 1968 championship season. It also includes uniform details from 1998 to 2018. Atlanta's threads include its iconic red helmet, which dates back to the 1960s, with black jerseys and white pants. 

The first NFL game in Paris brings a first in the uniform department for the Pittsburgh Steelers. Pittsburgh will rock their traditional white jerseys, but with color rush black pants, creating a combination never seen before for the franchise. The Steelers typically wear gold pants home or away. But, it will be a different look against the New Orleans Saints.

articles.description: Jim McCormick breaks down Saturday's slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.
articles.headlineJa: 土曜日のNBAファンタジーバスケットボール：おすすめの獲得選手とベッティング
articles.descriptionJa: ジム・マコーミックが土曜日の試合日程を分析し、ファンタジーで獲得すべきストリーマーやおすすめの賭け先を解説する。
articles.body:
ESPN's basketball daily cheat sheet is your pregame destination before you lock in daily fantasy and betting decisions for that night's games. Here you'll find our top insights for the slate, including players to target for your daily fantasy rosters, along with game-by-game injury reports.

What you need to know for Saturday

This first Saturday of the NBA regular season presents a mix of potential blowouts and battles. Five of Saturday's contests have large point spreads, while three have more competitive betting metrics.

Navigating big lines can prove challenging. Will the coaches abandon rotation patterns in the face of a blowout? A solid approach is to prioritize players whose value does not rely on a full fourth quarter; high-usage stars in competitive games, centers who can reach value through rebounds and blocks early, and starters with secure roles. Big lines still regularly surface from blowouts, as Stephen Curry has taught us over the past 15 years.

Potential blowouts don't automatically eliminate stars or create bench value. They simply add another variable: how much of a player's projection depends on a normal late-game workload. Compare that risk against matchup, injury news and the realistic likelihood the game stays close. The same idea applies to props: a large number is worth weighing, not treating as an automatic under.

Among the games with closer lines, the Miami Heat face the Charlotte Hornets in a game that feels important for Giannis Antetokounmpo and this new-look roster to prove competitive after a slow start. Conversely, Charlotte got drubbed last night by the Atlanta Hawks, setting up two division foes seeking redemption.

Speaking of the Hawks, they host the Houston Rockets in the marquee matchup of the day. These cross-conference teams boast deep rosters with gifted defenders, setting up an anticipated matchup for this initial weekend of the season.

With an eye toward uncovering compelling betting angles and fantasy decisions, let's take a look at the day ahead in the NBA.

Fantasy stream team -- widely available players worth adding

Davion Mitchell, PG, Miami Heat (rostered in 23.5% of ESPN leagues)

The Heat simply need more creation and scoring to complement Giannis and Bam Adebayo. Mitchell, thus far, has assumed more deliberate distribution duties for Miami versus last year's track meet agenda. With a strong floor for assists and steals and growing upside as a 3-point threat, Mitchell makes the cut as a top guard to consider today. It also helps that Charlotte is running a patchworked point guard rotation.

Naji Marshall, SF/PF, Dallas Mavericks (15.4%)

After proving himself as a steady bucket throughout last spring, Marshall is the clear favorite to assume heavy usage with Cooper Flagg likely sidelined with a shoulder injury suffered last night against the Indiana Pacers. articles.headline: Fantasy playbook: NFL Week 7 Shadow Reports, lineup locks and projected scores
articles.description: An all-encompassing look at the matchups to exploit or avoid and lineup locks in fantasy, as well as projected scores for all NFL games.
articles.body:
Welcome to The Playbook for Week 7, which kicked off Thursday night with a game between the Patriots and Bears.

This column features score projections, over/unders, win probabilities, and of course, easily digestible fantasy advice for seasonlong leagues and DFS. This guide should help you with all sorts of decision-making, including sit/start advice, last-minute waiver adds and lineup choices.

Additionally, we have folded our Shadow Reports into the game-by-game breakdowns here. Using our play-by-play data, we're able to identify defensive schemes and where each wide receiver and cornerback lines up on each play. By tracking these WR/CB matchups, including potential shadow situations, we can offer the best fantasy guidance each week.

articles.headline: Ex-NBA player Malik Beasley negotiating plea deal in gambling case
articles.description: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed.
articles.headlineJa: 元NBAのマリク・ビーズリー、賭博事件で司法取引を交渉中
articles.descriptionJa: 元NBA選手のマリク・ビーズリーが、贈収賄および賭博スキームへの関与の疑いを巡り、司法省の検察官と司法取引の交渉を行っていることが、弁護士の一人によって確認された。
articles.body:
Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed Saturday.

An overnight notice on the court docket indicated that Beasley, who played for six NBA teams over a nine-year career, intends to plead guilty in the case. Attorney Steve Haney told ESPN in a text message that Beasley has not signed a plea deal with prosecutors but that talks are ongoing and a decision is expected early this week.

A spokesperson for the Eastern District of New York did not immediately reply to follow-up questions about the matter.

Prosecutors allege that Beasley, 29, deliberately manipulated his statistics in at least four games during the 2023-24 season while he was with the Milwaukee Bucks so that gamblers could place and win bets on his performances.

According to the indictment, his co-defendants selected games that would not be nationally televised and Beasley decided whether he would underperform or overperform his scoring and rebounding.

Though he had earned tens of millions of dollars during his career, Beasley also accumulated "multimillion-dollar gambling losses" when he became part of the alleged scheme, according to the indictment.

Beasley faces federal counts of bribery in sporting contests, wire fraud conspiracy, honest services wire fraud conspiracy and money laundering conspiracy. He initially pleaded not guilty to all of the charges.

Late Friday, however, the judge overseeing his case asked a federal magistrate in Brooklyn to schedule a hearing for Beasley to change his plea. The judge filed a similar order Friday for another defendant in the case, Ernesto Plascencia. Plascencia's attorney confirmed Saturday morning that he will be entering a guilty plea.

One of the other defendants in the case, William Brown, pleaded guilty earlier this month, while fellow sports bettor Robert Gorodetsky is slated to formally enter a guilty plea Nov. 20.

Former NBA player Ed Davis and Paolo Zamorano, who was Davis' agent, were also charged in the case and have pleaded not guilty.

ABC News contributed to this report.
